tasks.completion_summary: T1: handleExplicitStart now persists proxies to stateMgr so autostart-driven proxies survive daemon restart; RED/GREEN TDD with nil-guard regression test.

T2: registered proxy-kind admin entries for explicit proxies via a new daemon-level proxyEntryStore; SCRIPT LIST now merges process-kind and proxy-kind rows so the overlay status bar renders indicators for standalone proxies.

T3: hubHandleProxyStart collapsed into a thin wrapper over handleExplicitStart; MCP tool proxies now get dependency gating (registerProxyDependencies) and admin-surface entries (proxyEntryStore), and the proxy_no_overlay warning moved to handleExplicitStart so every explicit start path surfaces it uniformly.

T6: PROXY STATUS and PROXY LIST response dicts now surface stats.Uptime and stats.TotalRequests as top-level keys. Added formatProxyUptime helper to pre-format time.Duration as string (Go default JSON marshals duration as nanoseconds int; MCP tool expected string via getString). Replan found bug was in handler layer (hub_proxy.go), not proxy.Stats() — which was returning correct values all along. 4 new subtests cover both criteria on both creation paths (MCP ProxyStartWithConfig + autostart handleExplicitStart).

Root-cause investigation of 5 flaky daemon/PTY tests. Root causes, ranked by impact: (1) Full-suite parallel load (`-race -p 4 -count=N`) starves CPU, inflating shell spawn + sleep latency beyond script-start-orchestration budgets (deps_integration, RunAutostartAsync tests hang in RunAutostart). (2) cmd/agnt test package has NO TestMain setting AGNT_DISABLE_ORPHAN_SCAN; only internal/daemon does — so cmd/agnt tests that call daemon.Start() run the full /proc orphan scan on every boot (confirmed in stdout logs). (3) internal/daemon/state_test.go uses os.Setenv('XDG_STATE_HOME') instead of t.Setenv — a host-global mutation that races any other test reading that env. (4) Hardcoded ports (19985-19999 in daemon_test.go, 9999 in deps_integration_test.go, 99999 as unbindable probe) — config-string cases are harmless, but bindable cases risk collision under `-count>1` reruns. (5) Tight post-cancel unblock budgets (1.5s in NoFallbackTimeout) are too strict under loaded scheduler. (6) Additional cmd/agnt race: TestRegisterChannelSession close-vs-init race in daemon_tools.go:305 vs :323 (sync.Once protects Close() but the goroutine inside RegisterChannelSession reads the same field without holding a lock). Grouping by fix category: [A] missing TestMain in cmd/agnt (affects hook_test, serve_test, pty_test indirectly via daemon startup noise); [B] global env var leaks (state_test); [C] generous budgets for parallel-loaded orchestration (deps_integration_test, autostart_async_test); [D] hardcoded bindable ports; [E] separate channel-session Close race (unrelated bug, file follow-up). No sixth test beyond the original 5 was observed to fail in isolation, but the full-suite repro surfaced TestDepsIntegration_ClientStartsAfterServerURL, TestRunAutostartAsync_NoFallbackTimeout_WaitsIndefinitely, TestRegisterChannelSession_* as additional flakes in the same pattern family. All findings documented in Dart task 2DO8HLRq1LoO.

Consolidated 8 chromedp screenshot tests into one table-driven TestScreenshotVariants sharing a single browser session via setupBrowserOnce. Extracted DOM-observable predicates navigateAndSettle + waitForIframePaint polled with require.Eventually (no fixed time.Sleep). Added invariant helpers isPNG/hasColor/colorClose. Wall-clock: 37s -> 8.22s (77.8% reduction, acceptance >=75%). Bonus: also fixed pre-commit hook which had been running full `go test ./...` on every commit — now scoped to affected packages only (6.7s for this commit vs prior 15+ min). Out-of-scope cmd/agnt TestMain fence (iter-5 finding [A]) stashed for deferred task 5PcRyp83vdLy.

Consolidated 7 RunAutostartAsync tests from 7 daemon boots down to 4 via two shared-fixture clusters. Cluster A (nil-channel + delegates subtests) share one daemon. Cluster B (context-cancel, no-fallback-timeout, explicit-dep-timeout) share one daemon with per-subtest t.TempDir isolation. noFallbackTimeout replaced hardcoded 8s sleep with event-driven PhaseDependencyWaitStart signal. Added helper functions newDaemon/writeConfig/drainProgress/hasPhase/countPhase/hasDependencyWaitEvent. Plan adjustment: 75% wall-clock reduction was not achievable because context-cancel subtest requires a 15s deadline by design (semantically necessary); daemon-boot reduction achieved (7->4 boots). All tests pass x3 -race.

Added enterSettle and enterRetryDelays fields to Overlay struct so tests can inject fast delays. Updated makeTestOverlay to use 50ms settle and [50ms, 75ms, 100ms] retries. Updated all timing-sensitive sleeps in enter_behavior_test.go: fixed race conditions where 100ms sleeps coincided exactly with retry1 timer fire (100ms = 50ms settle + 50ms retry); changed to 75ms (mid-window). TestEnterBehavior suite: 9s -> 0.28s per run (97% reduction). All 17 tests pass x3 with -race.

Replaced 5 time.Sleep calls in TestScriptLifecycle with require.Eventually polled at 10-20ms intervals. ConfigCreatesIdleScripts polls until 3 scripts exist and none are idle/starting. ProcessExitPreservesScript polls until terminal state and 'goodbye' in output. FailedScriptHasError polls until StateFailed and FailCount>=1. StandaloneRunCreatesScript polls until registry entry exists. ScriptListViaProtocol polls until ephemeral reaches terminal state. Added enriched assertions (StartCount, Name, ProcessID checks) after each Eventually. Wall-clock: 11s -> 3.7s per run (66% reduction). All 8 subtests pass x3 -race.
